rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user’s request was conditional (try split payment; if not, identify and cancel the most expensive item; if not, switch to cheapest options; if not, cancel the order). The agent skipped these steps and jumped straight to cancellation. Authentication steps are unclear from the conversation context, and the agent also provided a refund timeline without tool-backed confirmation. Therefore, the agent did not complete the user’s request in line with policy.
